cuts.item: pavement management line reduced to zero

statements.statement: The town manager presented a preliminary budget to the finance committee; to balance it the pavement management line was reduced to zero.
Chapter 90 apportionment received, substantially higher than prior years, contingent on a state bond authorization.
Possible use of one-time free cash to restore part of the pavement line, shown in a standalone warrant article placeholder.

warnings.condition: if the town buys 100 Townsend Harbor Road
warnings.prediction: Adding the Townsend Harbor Road purchase would require dramatic adjustment of the capital program and leave the next fiscal year with no starting free cash.
Changes could occur between the final budget and town meeting floor, and adjustments at a special town meeting; nothing will happen as normal this season.
